cues: The last movement is a double story.
On the surface, Durand sends his daughters upstairs to shut the windows.
He is tender to Thérèse: if she loves Antonio, she must marry him; you gave me so much joy as a child that you owe me nothing.
To Adèle alone he speaks in code.
Put out the stove: no fire of ours will be blamed.
Count the candles: five of six; the sixth is placed very high up, a fuse.
I am going away to get money for you, which is literally true.
